text: i was given really good service when i purchased the car. at that point i was tied up with work and hardly had any free time. the salesperson even said he could drive a car out for a test drive all the way from oulu to joensuu for me. in the end i managed to arrange the time on my own.

the bmw 530e has a full new luxury style, not just on the outside but inside too, with lots of safety systems from various angles in traffic for both driver and passengers. comfort is good, and the battery so far is fine, i get about 77 km in winter and around 94 km in summer. the driving feel is totally different and more comfortable than my old bmw 520d-2019. i recomend it as an economical car with good-luxury design, suitable as a family car, etc.

overall the car feels basically well built, but the price is still too high for what you actually get. there are several areas where it seems things have been pared back compared to what you would expect as obvious. it is not just about the equipment list you can read through (which you really have to study carefully, because it is very hard to understand exactly what the car has as standard). in terms of perceived quality, for example, the carpet in the boot and the standard radio have clearly been economised, which is far below what you expect from a premium brand. there are also obvious gaps in the standard equipment that ought to be a given and cost nothing, like the fact there is no cigar lighter socket in the trunk. you can see lines in the doors bulging slightly where the inner plate meets the edges, which feels far under the standard you would expect and becomes a daily irritation when you notice it. in the middle of the bonnet you can see a row of marks that look like spot welds from underneath. so in the end i actually regret buying it, even though in many ways it is a nice car.
